option-validation.prompt:
Reject options that do not apply to the selected command before prompting, reading ownership state, modifying files, or downloading. Exact accepted matrix: install: --tools (both --tools VALUE and --tools=VALUE), --dry-run, --backup; uninstall: --tools, --dry-run; init-project: --tools, --apply; cursor-rules: --print; update: --dry-run; status and doctor: no options. Existing required-value and required-option rules remain. Any recognized but inappropriate flag returns exit 2 with a helpful stderr error identifying command and flag and no stdout or work. Preserve no-argument help and top-level --help, -h, help behavior (including ignored trailing args), case-insensitive command names, and controlled errors for unknown commands/options. Preserve existing CliOptions.Parse public behavior; command-specific checks belong in dispatch. Keep all existing public APIs available; exercise behavior through HarnessApp.Run in the existing executable test project, not newly added test helper APIs. Add focused regression coverage. Do not change project files, dependencies, models.conf, instructions, embedded assets, or unrelated behavior. Run the existing .NET test suite. Only src/AgentHarness/*.cs and tests/AgentHarness.Tests/*.cs may change.

state-validation.prompt:

Exact version-1 schema (no extra fields): {"schemaVersion":1,"stateFile":<actual state.json path>,"tools":[{"name":"codex","ownedFiles":<integer>},{"name":"claude","ownedFiles":<integer>}],"cursorMode":"project-local"}. preview-execution.prompt:
Implement a reusable typed installation plan so install --dry-run and actual install execute the same classification. Scope: global install only; preserve public Install, Uninstall and InitProject signatures and behavior. Use existing public HarnessApp CLI for tests, without depending on any new helper API. Allowed edits: src/AgentHarness/*.cs and tests/AgentHarness.Tests/*.cs only. Do not change embedded assets, models, project files, workflow instructions or docs.
A dry-run must not write files, directories, backups or state anywhere. Against an unchanged isolated home/state, the next execution must report the same ordered action lines and same backup destinations as preview (only summary adds ' planned' during preview). Preserve current CREATE, UPDATE, UNCHANGED, CONFLICT, BACKUP, REPLACE, REMOVE stale CLI-owned skill file and PRESERVE stale skill file action vocabulary. Use 'Install complete: N file change(s)[ planned]. ' summary, with N counting creates, updates, replacements and stale removals, never conflicts, unchanged or preserved files. A file created or updated is owned; matching unowned files stay unowned. Update an unchanged owned older version. Preserve modified/unowned conflicts without --backup; with --backup choose an unoccupied deterministic backup name (any file/directory/link occupies a name), move original bytes once and replace with bundled bytes. Never overwrite a backup. Remove stale unchanged owned skill files only under selected tool skill roots; preserve stale modified, missing or unsafe paths. Do not traverse symlink/reparse parents or destinations, including stale entries. Preserve other tools and project initialization behavior. The plan should carry typed actions and content/backup decisions so preview and application share the same decisions; no new CLI flags or public planning API are required. Add focused regression tests.

verify-installed.prompt:
Add the read-only command verify-installed --tools codex,claude|all [--json]. Allowed edits: src/AgentHarness/*.cs and tests/AgentHarness.Tests/*.cs only. Do not change embedded assets, models, project files, workflow instructions or docs. Tests must use existing public HarnessApp CLI and must not depend on new helper APIs.
Require --tools; comma lists select codex and/or claude; case-insensitive all means exactly codex+claude for this command. Any selection containing cursor is usage error. Reject irrelevant flags --dry-run, --backup, --apply, --print. Preserve other commands' existing behavior. Compare every expected bundled/rendered global installation asset for selected tools with its installed destination (including model-rendered agent definitions and Claude skill exclusions). Ignore extra files and stale tracked entries. Report unchanged (matching regular bytes regardless of ownership), missing, modified (different regular bytes), or unsafe (directory, symbolic link/reparse destination, or any linked ancestor within the configured home, including that home). Treat ancestors above configured home/state-directory roots as trusted host paths; check the state directory itself and its state.json destination for links. Never follow links to read content. Never write any files/directories/state, claim ownership, remediate drift, access network or change configuration.
JSON stdout must be one object with version:1, files:[{path:<absolute destination>,status:<lowercase state>}], summary:{unchanged:<count>,missing:<count>,modified:<count>,unsafe:<count>}; no extra stdout text. Sort files by absolute path with ordinal ordering; summary counts cover all and only returned files. Default text must include each path and uppercase status and a human summary containing counts for the four lowercase status names. Exit 0 iff all expected files unchanged, 1 if any drift, 2 for usage or invalid state. A missing state is valid and must remain missing. Existing state must be a valid version-1 StateDocument with a nonnull Files dictionary, absolute keys and 64 hex digest values; malformed JSON, null document, invalid version/shape/hash/path, or unsafe linked state path returns 2 without writes. No extra schema/API required. Add focused tests and help guidance.
